result:
The bridge page works and renders real data from the knowledge graph:
- 11,600 entities, 134,868 facts
- Goals with projects listed under them  
- 166 sessions (125 running)
- Ready work queue (0 ready tasks currently)
- Auto-refresh via `<meta http-equiv="refresh" content="30">`

The plan-to-project matching shows 0/0 for all projects — the plan→project attribute matching needs the exact title strings to match. That's a data quality issue, not a code bug. The page renders and serves correctly.

**What was built:**
- `GET /bridge` — full bridge view HTML page at `web.rs:108-298`
- `mash-engine serve --port 8561` — standalone web server subcommand at `main.rs:57-60`
- Daemon mode now binds to port 8561 (was 5610) at `main.rs:133`
- Helper functions `entity_attr()`, `html_escape()` for safe HTML rendering
- UTF-8-safe string truncation for session task display

The page shows goals/projects, ready work, running sessions, and system stats in a dark-themed GitHub-style layout with 30-second auto-refresh.
